From Planet Waves · Price: outdoors only, and it takes time to arrive.

Theme Force and Energy

  • 1: 2 actions, outdoors: call a meteorite that lands at the start of your next turn on a 5-ft square: @Damage[(1+floor((@actor.level-1)/4))d6[bludgeoning],(1+floor((@actor.level-1)/4))d6[fire]] (@Check[reflex|against:stand|basic]{basic Reflex}).
  • 5: Surge: the meteor lands in a @Template[burst|distance:10]{10-ft burst}: @Damage[(ceil(@actor.level/2))d6[bludgeoning],(ceil(@actor.level/2))d6[fire]].
  • 9: The meteor can follow a creature you marked (it lands on its new space).
  • 13: Burst 20 ft.
  • 17: Two meteors per surge.

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC.
